name: 95128 · San Jose, CA
findings: ZIP 95128 (San Jose) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95128 (San Jose) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
